D: A lonely trash-compacting robot follows a sleek probe robot into space and changes the fate of humanity.
P: Serve the snacks when Wall-E watches Hello, Dolly! at home after work.
S: Hollowed cob loaf filled with pesto, ham and roasted peppers, pressed and sliced

A hollowed cob stuffed with layers of ham, roast capsicum, pesto, mozzarella and spinach, pressed overnight into a tight block and sliced into wedges. Cut the top off a 20cm round cob loaf and pull out most of the soft inside. Spread the inside with 4 tbsp basil pesto. Layer in 150g leg ham, 150g roasted capsicum, 150g sliced mozzarella, a handful of baby spinach, 100g salami and 100g semi-dried tomatoes, pressing each layer down. Replace the lid, wrap tightly in cling wrap and press under a heavy pot in the fridge overnight. Cut into wedges.
the little green plant he keeps in an old boot

Bright green peas smashed with mint, feta, lemon and olive oil, piled into a bowl with a sprout of pea shoots on top, with crunchy pita chips. Cook 400g frozen peas for 3 minutes, drain and cool under cold water. Pulse with a handful of mint, 100g feta, the zest and juice of a lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt until roughly smashed. Cut 4 pita breads into triangles, brush with oil and bake at 190C for 10 minutes until crisp. Pile the smash into a bowl, stand a few pea shoots in the middle and serve with the chips.
Marshmallow puffed rice cubes, stacked into trash towers
Butter and marshmallows melted slowly together, puffed rice stirred through, pressed into a lined tray, set an hour, cut into neat cubes and stacked into towers.
M: Pumpkin lentil soup in a mug
Time for lunch in a cup. Pumpkin, red lentil and coconut soup, ginger
A thick roast pumpkin and red lentil soup with ginger and coconut, served in big mugs with a straw. Grilled cheese on the side for the humans who remember chewing.
Earth garden roast veg and haloumi tray

Pumpkin, capsicum, red onion, zucchini and chickpeas roasted with honey and cumin, topped with golden haloumi, mint and a lemon yoghurt drizzle. Heat the oven to 220C. Toss 600g pumpkin chunks, 2 capsicums, 2 red onions in wedges, 2 zucchini and 1 drained tin chickpeas with 3 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tbsp honey and salt. Roast for 35 minutes, turning once. Slice 250g haloumi and fry until golden. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with lemon juice and salt. Top the tray with haloumi, drizzle with yoghurt and scatter with mint.
W: Light sponge fingers split and filled with piped cream
Eggs and sugar whisked pale and thick, flour folded in, baked as fingers at 180C for 12 minutes, cooled, split and filled with vanilla whipped cream piped through the middle.
K: Try blue. It's the new red. Frozen raspberries, lemon and blue cordial.

Fresh lemon juice, raspberries and a splash of blue cordial blended with ice into a frosty slushie, served in tall cups with a straw. Blend 150g frozen raspberries, the juice of 4 lemons, 80ml blue raspberry cordial, 3 tbsp caster sugar, 300ml cold water and 4 cups ice until smooth and slushy. Pour into tall cups and serve straight away with a straw and a lemon wheel.

m.note: Time for lunch in a cup. Pumpkin, red lentil and coconut soup, ginger
m.how: Soften an onion with 1 tbsp grated ginger. Add 800g diced pumpkin, 150g red lentils, 400ml coconut milk and 600ml water and simmer 25 minutes, then blitz. Serve in big mugs with a straw, and grilled cheese made from 8 slices sourdough and 150g cheddar on the side.
